text: Keep idea activity across backend restarts
description: The Activity coloring's access times live only in backend memory, and the dev backend restarts on every source change (tsx watch), so the graph goes dark exactly while agents are working. Persist the per-idea access vector in the project's gitignored runtime area (e.g. .bowman/runtime/ or the cache), written debounced and read on start. Drop entries that have faded below visibility so the file stays small. Not versioned in git: it's live state, not history.

status.comment: backend/src/idea-activity.ts: per-project activity loads lazily from .bowman/runtime/idea-activity.json (gitignored), saves 2s debounced after accesses and on process exit, and drops kinds below strength 0.005 (ideas with none left) on every save. Writes only into existing project dirs. Verified: idea-activity tests 4/4 (new: round-trip without faded entries), backend tsc clean; live: an MCP get_idea on the running dev backend wrote the file with that idea's read level. Restart reload itself covered by the unit test, not by restarting the dev server.
